analysis:
This PR changes documentation only, in two places.

1. docs/architecture/prefix-cache.md head line 689: the gpt-oss-20b checkpoint size row now reads bf16 K/V on all 24 layers. The listed sizes changed to 3.15 MB fixed state, 25.17 MB per 1,024 tokens (24,576 B per token) and 154.1 MB at 6,144 tokens. The previous row read float32 K/V on 23 of 24 layers. This is a descriptive layout and size figure.

2. docs/reference/configuration.md head line 594: a note was added that bf16 GPT-OSS keeps bf16 activations, so MLX_QUANTIZED_CONSTANT_CACHE does not apply to it.

Security assessment against T-041 and SEC-035:
- No change to at-rest encryption or HMAC naming.
- No change to cacheSalt scoping, TTL, disk budget or the DARKBLOOM_PREFIX_CACHE gate.
- No change to the AAD metadata fields or staging release paths.

The smaller per-file size may affect the file-size metadata visible at rest. T-041 already accepts file size as residual metadata, so this is not a regression.

The dtype claim is consistent with the doc's statement (head lines 427-431) that storage identity includes every layer's dtype. That identity enters the compatibility fingerprint and disk namespace, so files written under a float32 layout would not be reinterpreted under bf16. The supporting source code was not supplied, so this binding is unverified here.

No code was changed in this batch, and no threat-model update is needed.
